mapper.sql: id, username, password_hash, real_name, role_code, email, phone, status, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schema_common.sys_user (username, password_hash, real_name, role_code, email, phone, status) VALUES (#{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{realName}, #{roleCode}, #{email}, #{phone}, COALESCE(#{status}, 1))
mapper.update: UPDATE schema_common.sys_user SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT rp.module AS "module", rp.permissions AS "permissions" FROM schema_common.sys_role_permission rp JOIN schema_common.sys_role r ON rp.role_id = r.id JOIN schema_common.sys_user u ON u.role_code = r.role_code WHERE u.id = #{userId}
